research_question: Does removing only F8 or only F7, nominated by the completed label-free QC audit, improve participant-first LOW/HIGH balanced accuracy?
alignment: fixed EEG(t-10s) -> PM(t); existing exact pairing only
overall_aggregation: average available PM metrics/deltas within each subject, then equal subject weight
decision_rule: 95% paired participant CI entirely above zero: evidence of improvement under this protocol; includes zero: inconclusive/approximately neutral; entirely below zero: reduced performance; no further channel selection
dc_offset_note: SD-based motivation is invariant to additive DC offset; RMS and some roughness metrics are offset-sensitive. No preprocessing changes.
multiplicity: Each prespecified channel has a marginal 95% CI; no family-wise adjustment, no ranking.
